question: From Beatrice’s perspective, what are the things she would come to love even more about Subaru as an old man? Are there any "charm points" she would find specifically because he has aged?
answer: Considering how close those two became in just the one year between Arc 4 and Arc 5, after 40 years, their love will have grown incredibly deep. Beatrice would likely enjoy helping style Subaru's beard and hairstyle to suit her own tastes while doting on him.
